claim: Cryptocurrencies consumed about 125 TWh in 2023 and are tracked separately from data centres by the IEA, which means the 415 TWh data-centre baseline excludes crypto entirely.
comparisonContext: This is a useful reminder that AI is adding to an already large digital-infrastructure base rather than creating electricity demand from zero.
scopeNote: Crypto is counted outside the ICT/data-centre total in the IEA framing used here.
